instruction: The Stage-1, Stage-2, and Phase-E records are immutable. Inspect the paired case only now. Classify provenance for every Phase-E missing client fact, distinguish sibling necessity from corroboration, apply the fixed verdict precedence, and record narrow bilingual/clinical/scope collateral observations. Do not revise Phase E and do not propose content edits beyond an advisory P0-P3 priority.

content.en:
52-year-old woman; new-patient primary care visit. No primary care for about 6 years. Works full-time as a hotel housekeeper on rotating shifts, including weekends. Primary caregiver for 78-year-old mother.
Medication: ibuprofen as needed for work-related shoulder pain. No known drug allergies.
Preventive history: Pap smear about 10 years ago; never had a mammogram or colonoscopy; uncertain vaccination history; possible tetanus shot 5-6 years ago; no recalled shingles vaccine.
Family history: mother diagnosed with colon cancer at age 58; father died of myocardial infarction at age 71; sister age 56 healthy.
Insurance/social barriers: employer-sponsored high-deductible plan; concerned about cost. Speaks English fluently and completed high school, but left several intake sections blank and wrote, "not sure what this means."
content.zh:
52 岁女性；新患者初级保健就诊。约 6 年未看初级保健医生。全职酒店客房清洁员，轮班且包括周末；主要照顾 78 岁同住母亲。
用药：因工作相关肩痛按需服用布洛芬。无已知药物过敏。
预防保健史：约 10 年前做过 Pap 涂片；从未做过乳房 X 线摄影或结肠镜；疫苗史不确定；可能 5–6 年前因手部割伤打过破伤风针；不记得接种过带状疱疹疫苗。
家族史：母亲 58 岁诊断结肠癌；父亲 71 岁死于心肌梗死；56 岁姐姐健康。
保险/社会障碍：雇主提供的高免赔额保险；担心费用。英语流利并在美国完成高中，但多处入院表格留空，并写下“not sure what this means”。

content.en:
Cervical cancer screening: average-risk women age 30-65: Pap with HPV co-testing every 5 years or Pap alone every 3 years.
Breast cancer screening: mammography every 1-2 years beginning at age 40, with shared decision-making about frequency.
Colorectal cancer screening: average risk begins at age 45; options include annual FIT or colonoscopy every 10 years. Increased risk with a first-degree relative diagnosed with colorectal cancer before age 60: colonoscopy beginning at age 40 or 10 years before the relative's age at diagnosis, whichever is earlier; repeat every 5 years if normal. Stool-based tests are not first-line for this increased-risk group.
Immunizations: recombinant zoster vaccine two-dose series for adults age 50 and older; influenza vaccine annually in the fall; Tdap booster every 10 years.
content.zh:
宫颈癌筛查：30–65 岁平均风险女性：Pap 联合 HPV 检测每 5 年一次，或单独 Pap 每 3 年一次。
乳腺癌筛查：从 40 岁开始每 1–2 年乳房 X 线摄影一次，频率通过共同决策确定。
结直肠癌筛查：平均风险从 45 岁开始；可选每年 FIT 或每 10 年结肠镜。若一级亲属 60 岁前诊断结直肠癌，属风险增加：从 40 岁或比亲属诊断年龄提前 10 年开始结肠镜，以较早者为准；若正常，每 5 年重复。该风险增加人群不以粪便检测作为首选筛查。
免疫接种：50 岁及以上成人重组带状疱疹疫苗两剂系列；秋季每年流感疫苗；Tdap 每 10 年加强一次。

content.en:
Subjective: "My daughter kept telling me I need to get checked. I feel fine. I don't know why I need all these tests when nothing is wrong." Reports past visits used words she did not understand and she "just nodded along." Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, weight loss, bleeding, lumps, or bowel habit changes.
Vital signs: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C) oral, HR 76 regular, BP 124/78, RR 14, SpO2 99% on room air. Height 163 cm, weight 74 kg, BMI 27.8.
Exam: alert, oriented, cooperative. Heart/lungs/abdomen unremarkable. Mild right supraspinatus tenderness without swelling or reduced range of motion. Reads pamphlet slowly, holds it at arm's length, then sets it down.
Labs/screening today: non-fasting fingerstick glucose 118 mg/dL. Urine dipstick negative for protein, glucose, blood, leukocyte esterase, and nitrites. Newest Vital Sign score 1/6, consistent with high likelihood of limited health literacy. Fasting glucose and lipid panel ordered for return visit.
content.zh:
主观资料：“我女儿一直叫我来检查。我感觉很好。没有不舒服，为什么要做这么多检查？” 她说过去就诊时医护人员用了许多她听不懂的词，她“只是点头”。否认胸痛、气短、体重下降、出血、肿块或排便习惯改变。
生命体征：口温 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 76 次/分且规则，BP 124/78，RR 14 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 99%。身高 163 cm，体重 74 kg，BMI 27.8。
查体：清醒、定向力正常、配合。心肺腹无明显异常。右冈上肌轻度压痛，无肿胀或活动受限。阅读宣传单速度慢，拿得较远，几秒后放下。
今日实验室/筛查：非空腹指尖血糖 118 mg/dL。尿试纸蛋白、葡萄糖、潜血、白细胞酯酶、亚硝酸盐均阴性。Newest Vital Sign 得分 1/6，提示高度可能健康素养受限。已为复诊预约空腹血糖和血脂。

glossary.defZh: 一种简短的健康素养筛查工具，用来评估患者理解健康信息的可能困难。
患者难以理解、评估或应用健康信息。
使用患者容易理解的词语解释健康信息。

segments.en: Maria left several intake sections blank and wrote, "not sure what this means."
segments.zh: Maria 多处入院表格留空，并写下“not sure what this means”。

segments.en: Newest Vital Sign score is 1 out of 6.
She reads the pamphlet slowly, holds it at arm's length, and sets it down.
segments.zh: 她阅读宣传单很慢，把资料拿得较远，几秒后放下。

segments.en: She fidgets with her purse strap and avoids eye contact.
segments.zh: 她摆弄手提包带并避免眼神接触。

segments.en: She says a previous provider used words she did not understand and she just nodded along.
segments.zh: 她说以前的医护人员用了她听不懂的词，她只是点头。
非空腹指尖血糖为 118 mg/dL。

segments.en: There is mild right supraspinatus tenderness without reduced range of motion.
segments.zh: 右冈上肌轻度压痛，但活动范围未受限。

byChoice.en: Blank sections with a written note of confusion are a direct cue that written materials or forms may not be understandable without support.
byChoice.zh: 表格留空并写明看不懂，直接提示书面材料或表格可能需要额外解释。

byChoice.en: A Newest Vital Sign score of 1/6 supports a high likelihood of limited health literacy and changes the education approach.
byChoice.zh: Newest Vital Sign 1/6 支持高度可能健康素养受限，会改变宣教方式。

byChoice.en: Slow reading and holding the pamphlet at arm's length may reflect literacy and possible vision barriers that affect teaching materials.
byChoice.zh: 阅读慢、拿得较远可能反映健康素养和视力方面的障碍，会影响宣教材料使用。

byChoice.en: Fidgeting and avoiding eye contact are cues of discomfort or embarrassment, not proof of refusal or disinterest.
byChoice.zh: 摆弄物品和避免眼神接触提示不适或尴尬，而不是拒绝或不关心。

byChoice.en: Her prior experience of not understanding medical words identifies a communication barrier the nurse must address early.
byChoice.zh: 她曾听不懂医学用语，说明护士需尽早处理沟通障碍。

byChoice.en: This blood pressure is baseline clinical data and does not determine the communication strategy.
byChoice.zh: 该血压属于基础临床资料，不决定沟通策略。

byChoice.en: A single non-fasting glucose value should be followed as ordered, but it is not the cue that shapes how the nurse teaches today.
byChoice.zh: 单次非空腹血糖可按医嘱随访，但不是今天决定护士如何宣教的关键线索。

byChoice.en: Mild shoulder tenderness is relevant to the history but not to the immediate health-literacy communication plan.
byChoice.zh: 轻度肩部压痛与病史相关，但不影响立即的健康素养沟通计划。

correct.en: Blank forms, a very low health-literacy score, difficulty using the pamphlet, discomfort behaviors, and a statement about nodding along when she did not understand all directly shape the communication plan. They support plain language, pacing, and teach-back. Normal vital signs, a single non-fasting glucose of 118 mg/dL, and mild shoulder tenderness are baseline findings but do not drive the immediate communication strategy.
correct.zh: 表格留空、健康素养筛查得分很低、使用宣传单困难、不安行为，以及曾因听不懂而只是点头的陈述，都会直接影响沟通计划。这些线索提示需要使用通俗语言、放慢节奏并采用回授法。正常生命体征、单次非空腹血糖 118 mg/dL 和轻度肩痛属于基础资料，但不决定立即的沟通策略。

stem.en: Highlight the findings that are relevant to planning the nurse's communication approach for this visit.
stem.zh: 请标出与护士本次就诊沟通方式计划相关的发现。

testTakingStrategy.en: For recognize-cues items, group findings by the decision being made. Here the decision is communication planning, not diagnosing diabetes or treating shoulder pain.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 识别线索题要按当前决策来分组。本题决策是沟通计划，而不是诊断糖尿病或处理肩痛。

glossary.defZh: 用内镜检查结肠和直肠，可发现并处理息肉或异常。
在无症状时寻找结肠或直肠癌前病变或早期癌症。
因家族史等因素导致筛查需更早或更频繁。

options.en: Schedule colorectal cancer screening with colonoscopy.
options.zh: 安排结肠镜进行结直肠癌筛查。

options.en: Schedule cervical cancer screening with Pap/HPV co-testing.
options.zh: 安排 Pap/HPV 联合检测进行宫颈癌筛查。

options.en: Complete fasting glucose and lipid testing before any cancer screening is scheduled.
options.zh: 先完成空腹血糖和血脂检查，再安排任何癌症筛查。

options.en: Schedule screening mammography.
options.zh: 安排筛查性乳房 X 线摄影。

options.en: Administer the influenza vaccine today.
options.zh: 今天接种流感疫苗。

byChoice.en: This directly addresses the increased-risk colorectal-screening indication created by a first-degree relative diagnosed before age 60.
byChoice.zh: 该项直接处理一级亲属 60 岁前患病所导致的结直肠癌风险增加筛查适应证。

byChoice.en: Mammography is due by age, but it is not as strongly individualized by the family-history risk described in the protocol.
byChoice.zh: 按年龄应做乳房 X 线筛查，但其个体化风险权重不如方案中结肠癌家族史所提示的结肠镜。

byChoice.en: Cervical screening is overdue, but the case's strongest individualized risk factor is the family history driving earlier colonoscopy.
byChoice.zh: 宫颈筛查确实逾期，但本病例最强的个体化风险因素是家族史导致需更早结肠镜。

byChoice.en: Fasting labs are appropriate follow-up, but the available glucose does not justify delaying indicated cancer screening.
byChoice.zh: 空腹化验适合作为随访，但现有血糖资料不足以成为推迟癌症筛查的理由。

byChoice.en: The influenza vaccine is an immediate operational task, not the highest-priority screening risk.
byChoice.zh: 流感疫苗是可立即完成的操作性任务，但不是最高优先级的筛查风险。

correct.en: Maria's mother is a first-degree relative diagnosed with colorectal cancer before age 60. Under the clinic protocol, Maria should have begun colonoscopy at age 40 or 10 years before her mother's diagnosis, whichever was earlier; age 40 is earlier than age 48. At age 52 with no prior colonoscopy, she is 12 years beyond the risk-stratified start point. Cervical and breast screening are also important, and influenza vaccine can be completed today, but colonoscopy is the highest-priority screening risk to address.
correct.zh: Maria 的母亲是一级亲属，且 60 岁前诊断结直肠癌。按诊所方案，Maria 应从 40 岁或比母亲诊断年龄提前 10 年开始结肠镜，以较早者为准；40 岁早于 48 岁。她现在 52 岁且从未做过结肠镜，已超过风险分层起始年龄 12 年。宫颈和乳腺筛查也重要，流感疫苗可今日完成，但结肠镜是最优先处理的筛查风险。

stem.en: Based on the clinic preventive-care protocol and the Stage 1 data, which overdue screening is the highest priority for the nurse to address first?
stem.zh: 依据诊所预防保健方案和阶段 1 资料，护士应首先重点处理哪项逾期筛查？

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not equate the quickest task with the highest priority. Rank preventive needs by individualized risk and the strength of the indication.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要把最快能完成的任务等同于最高优先级。应按个体化风险和适应证强度排序预防需求。

glossary.defZh: 通过倾听、反映和确认感受来建立信任并支持患者决策。
承认患者感受或处境是真实且可以理解的。
因恐惧或压力而避免面对健康问题或检查。

options.en: "Colonoscopy is very safe, and survival is much better when cancer is found early."
options.zh: “结肠镜很安全，而且癌症早发现时存活率高得多。”

options.en: "Your health has to come first, even if taking time off is hard."
options.zh: “即使请假困难，你的健康也必须排第一。”

options.en: "I will give you the scheduling number so you can book the procedure when you are ready."
options.zh: “我把预约电话给你，你准备好时自己安排检查。”

options.en: "You have no symptoms, so you should not worry about colon cancer right now."
options.zh: “你现在没有症状，所以现在不用担心结肠癌。”

options.en: "Your mother's experience sounds frightening, and losing work time is a real concern. Let's talk through both before we decide next steps."
options.zh: “你母亲的经历听起来很可怕，请假影响工作也是现实担忧。我们先一起谈谈这两点，再决定下一步。”

byChoice.en: Giving a number without addressing fear or barriers leaves the core problem unresolved.
byChoice.zh: 只给预约电话而不处理恐惧和障碍，会让核心问题仍未解决。

byChoice.en: This is judgmental and dismisses a real employment and financial barrier.
byChoice.zh: 这带有评判性，忽视了真实的就业和经济障碍。

byChoice.en: This minimizes her fear and also blurs the point that screening is for asymptomatic people.
byChoice.zh: 这会淡化她的恐惧，也模糊了筛查正是面向无症状人群的概念。

byChoice.en: Facts may be useful later, but leading with statistics before acknowledging fear is a communication barrier.
byChoice.zh: 事实资料稍后可能有用，但在回应恐惧前先讲数据会形成沟通障碍。

byChoice.en: This response reflects fear, validates the work barrier, and invites collaborative problem-solving.
byChoice.zh: 该回应反映恐惧、确认工作障碍，并邀请共同解决问题。

correct.en: Maria is showing fear and a defensive posture. The nurse should first acknowledge the emotional barrier and validate the practical work barrier without judgment. This builds trust and makes later education possible. Facts, reassurance, or scheduling instructions given before the emotion is addressed are less likely to be heard and may increase avoidance.
correct.zh: Maria 表现出恐惧和防御姿态。护士应首先承认情绪障碍，并非评判性地确认工作请假的现实困难。这样能建立信任，使后续宣教成为可能。在情绪未被回应前直接给数据、安慰或安排预约，往往难以被听进去，还可能加重回避。

stem.en: When colonoscopy is mentioned, Maria says she does not want to know if she has cancer and cannot take a day off work. She crosses her arms and looks toward the door. Which response by the nurse is best first?
stem.zh: 提到结肠镜时，Maria 说她不想知道自己是否有癌症，也不能请一天假。她双臂交叉并看向门口。护士首先应如何回应最合适？

testTakingStrategy.en: When a client shows fear or defensiveness, choose the response that acknowledges feelings before teaching or persuading.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当患者表现出恐惧或防御时，优先选择先承认感受、再宣教或劝导的回应。

glossary.defZh: 无症状时为了早期发现问题而做的检查。
因症状或异常发现而寻找原因的检查。
用于预防带状疱疹及其并发症的疫苗。

columns.zh: 需要针对性重新宣教/随访

rows.en: She correctly connects the Pap smear, mammogram, and colonoscopy with the appropriate body areas and recognizes the family-history link for colonoscopy.
rows.zh: 她能将 Pap、乳房 X 线和结肠镜与相应身体部位联系起来，并认识到结肠镜与家族史有关。

rows.en: She says each cancer screening is needed because she might already have cancer.
rows.zh: 她说每项癌症筛查都是因为她可能已经患癌。

rows.en: She states that the influenza vaccine is to help prevent influenza.
rows.zh: 她说流感疫苗是为了帮助预防流感。

rows.en: She omits the recombinant zoster vaccine from the plan.
rows.zh: 她没有提到重组带状疱疹疫苗。

rows.en: She says her blood sugar is fine, so she does not need to worry about anything else.
rows.zh: 她说血糖没事，所以其他都不用担心。

byChoice.en: This part is adequate because she identifies the general purpose areas and the colonoscopy risk factor.
byChoice.zh: 这一部分理解充分，因为她能识别大致筛查部位和结肠镜风险因素。

byChoice.en: This needs reteaching because screening is done when the client feels well, not because the nurse suspects cancer is already present.
byChoice.zh: 这需要重新宣教，因为筛查是在无症状时进行，不是因为护士怀疑已经有癌症。

byChoice.en: This is an adequate plain-language understanding of influenza vaccination.
byChoice.zh: 这是对流感疫苗作用的通俗且充分的理解。

byChoice.en: Omitting the zoster vaccine is a gap because it is part of the age-based preventive plan.
byChoice.zh: 遗漏带状疱疹疫苗是理解缺口，因为它是按年龄推荐的预防计划之一。

byChoice.en: This needs follow-up because fasting glucose and lipids were ordered and the single non-fasting value does not close the preventive-care plan.
byChoice.zh: 这需要随访，因为已安排空腹血糖和血脂；单次非空腹数值不能代表预防保健计划已完成。

correct.en: Teach-back is partially correct. Maria can match the screenings to the correct body areas and understands the family-history reason for colonoscopy, and she understands the influenza vaccine. However, she still equates screening with suspected cancer, omits the zoster vaccine, and incorrectly concludes that no other follow-up is needed because the non-fasting glucose was not alarming. These gaps require focused reteaching rather than repeating the entire visit from the beginning.
correct.zh: 回授结果部分正确。Maria 能把筛查与正确身体部位对应，也理解结肠镜与家族史有关，并理解流感疫苗作用。但她仍把筛查等同于怀疑已有癌症，遗漏带状疱疹疫苗，并错误认为非空腹血糖不严重就不需其他随访。这些缺口需要有针对性地重新宣教，而不是从头重复整次宣教。

stem.en: Classify each part of Maria's Stage 2 teach-back as either adequate understanding or needing targeted reteaching/follow-up.
stem.zh: 请判断 Maria 在阶段 2 回授中的每一部分，是理解充分，还是需要有针对性地重新宣教/随访。

testTakingStrategy.en: Teach-back is not pass/fail. Identify what is correct, then target the missing or unsafe pieces.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 回授不是简单合格/不合格。先找出正确部分，再针对遗漏或不安全部分重新宣教。

glossary.defZh: 妨碍患者获得或完成护理的因素，如费用、交通、工作或照护责任。
协助患者了解保险覆盖、账单和费用问题的工作人员。
患者外出就医时由他人暂时代为照顾依赖者。

options.en: Offer fasting labs through a walk-in lab or other option that fits her work schedule.
options.zh: 提供可配合其工作时间的步入式实验室或其他方式完成空腹化验。

options.en: Schedule the colonoscopy, Pap/HPV test, vaccines, and labs on separate days so each topic can be discussed in isolation.
options.zh: 将结肠镜、Pap/HPV、疫苗和化验都安排在不同日期，以便每个主题单独讨论。

options.en: Use plain-language teaching and teach-back at each encounter, including vaccine and follow-up instructions.
options.zh: 每次接触都使用通俗语言和回授法，包括疫苗和随访说明。

options.en: Help Maria identify caregiver coverage for her mother on appointment or procedure days.
options.zh: 帮助 Maria 确认预约或检查当天谁能照看她的母亲。

options.en: Consolidate appointments when possible, such as pairing Pap/HPV testing with the colonoscopy-prep teaching visit.
options.zh: 尽可能合并预约，例如将 Pap/HPV 检测与结肠镜准备宣教安排在同一天。

options.en: Connect Maria with the financial counselor before colonoscopy scheduling is finalized.
options.zh: 在最终安排结肠镜前，帮助 Maria 联系财务顾问。

byChoice.en: Flexible lab completion makes the ordered fasting glucose and lipid panel more achievable.
byChoice.zh: 灵活完成化验能让已医嘱的空腹血糖和血脂更容易落实。

byChoice.en: Consolidation directly reduces the number of days Maria must miss work or arrange caregiver help.
byChoice.zh: 合并预约可直接减少 Maria 请假和安排照护的次数。

byChoice.en: Financial counseling gives plan-specific answers and prevents vague reassurance from failing her cost concern.
byChoice.zh: 财务顾问能提供针对其保险的答案，避免用笼统安慰应付费用担忧。

byChoice.en: Limited health literacy requires ongoing accommodation, not a one-time explanation.
byChoice.zh: 健康素养受限需要持续调整沟通方式，而不是一次解释就结束。

byChoice.en: Caregiver coverage is a real adherence barrier because Maria is responsible for her mother.
byChoice.zh: 照护安排是真实的依从性障碍，因为 Maria 负责照顾母亲。

byChoice.en: Separating every item into different visits magnifies the work and caregiver barriers and increases the chance of missed follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 把每项都分散到不同就诊会放大工作和照护障碍，增加失访可能。

correct.en: Maria's barriers are practical and communication-related: rotating work, caregiver duties, cost concerns, and limited health literacy. The plan should reduce visit burden, address insurance questions before scheduling, make labs feasible, arrange caregiver coverage, and preserve plain-language teach-back. Scheduling everything on separate days increases the number of days off and caregiver arrangements required, which undermines follow-through.
correct.zh: Maria 的障碍包括现实安排和沟通两方面：轮班工作、照护责任、费用担忧和健康素养受限。计划应减少就诊负担，在安排前处理保险问题，使化验可行，安排照护支持，并持续使用通俗语言和回授法。把所有事项分散到不同日期会增加请假和照护安排次数，反而削弱落实可能性。

stem.en: Which nursing actions best address Maria's barriers while sequencing the remaining preventive-care plan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 护士应采取哪些措施，以在安排后续预防保健时处理 Maria 的障碍？请选择所有适用项。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a client has adherence barriers, the best nursing actions make the care plan easier to complete without removing required safety steps.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当患者有落实障碍时，最佳护理措施是在不省略必要安全步骤的前提下，让计划更容易完成。

glossary.defZh: 提示可能需要及时评估的症状，如便血、持续排便改变或不明原因体重下降。
针对已出现症状或异常结果进一步查明原因的评估。
按计划完成预约、检查和后续行动。

options.en: It is incomplete because she must be taught to call the clinic promptly for new symptoms, then repeat teach-back.
options.zh: 回授不完整；必须教她若出现新症状应立即联系诊所，然后再次回授确认。

options.en: It indicates the nurse should request FIT instead of colonoscopy because Maria remains anxious.
options.zh: 这说明她仍焦虑，护士应改为申请 FIT 而不是结肠镜。

options.en: It indicates she needs detailed cancer survival statistics to motivate faster follow-through.
options.zh: 这说明她需要详细癌症存活率数据，以促使她更快落实。

options.en: It indicates she should cancel the screening colonoscopy and wait until symptoms develop.
options.zh: 这说明她应取消筛查性结肠镜，等出现症状后再检查。

options.en: It is adequate because she understands the purpose of the colonoscopy and has already scheduled it.
options.zh: 回授充分，因为她已理解结肠镜目的并已安排检查。

byChoice.en: Her understanding is only partial; waiting to report new symptoms could delay evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 她只是部分理解；等待报告新症状可能延误评估。

byChoice.en: She is asymptomatic now and appropriately scheduled for screening; the issue is what to do if symptoms appear before then.
byChoice.zh: 她目前无症状，已合理安排筛查；问题在于若预约前出现症状该怎么办。

byChoice.en: The clinic protocol identifies colonoscopy as the first-line screening for her increased-risk history; anxiety should be addressed with communication and support, not by substituting an inappropriate first-line test.
byChoice.zh: 诊所方案将结肠镜作为她风险增加病史的首选筛查；焦虑应通过沟通和支持处理，而不是替换成不合适的首选检查。

byChoice.en: Fear-based or data-heavy teaching may increase anxiety and does not target the specific misunderstanding.
byChoice.zh: 以恐惧或大量数据为主的宣教可能增加焦虑，也没有针对具体误解。

byChoice.en: This identifies the safety gap and closes the loop with repeat teach-back.
byChoice.zh: 该项识别安全缺口，并通过再次回授闭环确认。

correct.en: Maria understands the purpose of screening but has a critical safety gap: she would wait to report symptoms that could require earlier diagnostic evaluation. The nurse should correct the misunderstanding calmly, explain that new symptoms change the situation from routine screening to diagnostic follow-up, and repeat teach-back to confirm understanding.
correct.zh: Maria 理解筛查目的，但存在关键安全缺口：她会等到预约时才报告可能需要更早诊断性评估的症状。护士应平静地纠正误解，说明新症状会使情况从常规筛查转为诊断性随访，并再次回授确认理解。

stem.en: At the follow-up visit, Maria correctly explains why she is having a colonoscopy but says she would wait until the scheduled procedure to mention new blood in stool, bowel habit changes, or unexplained weight loss. How should the nurse evaluate this teach-back?
stem.zh: 随访时，Maria 能正确解释为什么要做结肠镜，但表示如果在预约前出现便血、排便习惯改变或不明原因体重下降，她会等到结肠镜当天再说。护士应如何评价这次回授？

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by looking for unsafe omissions, not just correct statements. A correct explanation can still miss a key safety instruction.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时要寻找不安全的遗漏，而不只看说对了什么。即使解释正确，也可能漏掉关键安全指导。

content.en: The nurse reviews the blank intake sections and asks about family history. Maria says, "My mom had something in her intestines; they took part of it out. I don't really know the details." The nurse identifies overdue cervical, breast, and colorectal cancer screening; influenza vaccine due in early October; recombinant zoster vaccine eligibility by age; and Tdap status requiring clarification. When colonoscopy is mentioned, Maria says quietly, "My mom almost died from that cancer. I don't want to know if I have it. And I can't take a day off work for that — they'll fire me." She crosses her arms and looks toward the door.
content.zh: 护士查看表格留空处并询问家族史。Maria 说：“我妈妈肠子里有东西，他们切掉了一部分。我真的不清楚细节。” 护士确认宫颈癌、乳腺癌和结直肠癌筛查均逾期；10 月初应接种流感疫苗；按年龄符合重组带状疱疹疫苗接种条件；Tdap 状态需进一步确认。提到结肠镜时，Maria 低声说：“我妈妈差点因为那个癌症死掉。我不想知道我是不是也有。而且我不能请一天假，老板会开除我的。” 她双臂交叉，看向门口。

content.en: After empathic, plain-language teaching, the nurse asks for teach-back. Maria says, "So you're saying I need the Pap smear because I might have cancer down there, and the mammogram because I might have breast cancer, and the colonoscopy because my mom had it. And the influenza shot is so I don't get the flu. And my blood sugar is fine so I don't need to worry about anything else." The nurse identifies partial understanding, reteaches the difference between screening and diagnostic testing using a smoke-detector analogy, and repeats teaching about the shingles vaccine and fasting labs. Maria then says she understands.
content.zh: 在使用同理、通俗语言宣教后，护士请 Maria 用自己的话回授。Maria 说：“所以你是说我要做 Pap，因为我可能下面有癌；做乳房 X 线，因为我可能有乳腺癌；做结肠镜，因为我妈妈得过。流感针是为了不得流感。我的血糖没事，所以其他就不用担心了。” 护士判断其理解部分正确，使用烟雾报警器类比重新解释筛查与诊断检查的区别，并再次说明带状疱疹疫苗和空腹化验。Maria 随后表示理解。

title.zh: 通俗语言宣教与回授法

content.en: Maria can do in-clinic tasks today but worries about time off, caregiver coverage, and cost. The nurse explains that most preventive screenings are covered without copay under her plan but that billing details can vary; the financial counselor can review her exact plan before scheduling colonoscopy. Influenza vaccine is administered in the left deltoid under standing order and is tolerated well. Maria can return on a Tuesday morning in two weeks but may need daughter coverage for her mother. The nurse documents rotating schedule, caregiver responsibilities, cost concerns, and limited health literacy requiring plain-language communication and teach-back.
content.zh: Maria 可以今天完成诊所内项目，但担心请假、照顾母亲和费用。护士解释其保险多数预防性筛查无共付，但账单细节可能不同；财务顾问可在安排结肠镜前核对她的具体保险。按常规医嘱在左三角肌接种流感疫苗，耐受良好。Maria 可在两周后的周二上午回来，但可能需要女儿帮忙照看母亲。护士记录障碍：轮班工作、照护责任、费用担忧，以及健康素养受限，需要每次接触都使用通俗语言和回授法。

title.zh: 围绕障碍制定随访计划
阶段 2——同次就诊 45–75 分钟

content.en:
Maria reports that the financial counselor confirmed the colonoscopy will be fully covered as a screening procedure. Colonoscopy is scheduled for the following month when her daughter can stay with her mother. Fasting labs: glucose 104 mg/dL, total cholesterol 212 mg/dL, LDL 134 mg/dL, HDL 52 mg/dL, triglycerides 130 mg/dL. Provider plans lifestyle counseling and no medication today. Vital signs: T 98.1 °F (36.7 °C), HR 72, BP 122/76, RR 14, SpO2 99% on room air. The nurse administers the first recombinant zoster vaccine dose in the right deltoid, schedules Pap with HPV co-testing for the same day as the colonoscopy-prep teaching visit, and schedules the second zoster dose 2-6 months later.
Teach-back: Maria explains that colonoscopy uses a camera to look for intestinal growths before cancer develops and that she is doing it because her mother had colon cancer. When asked what to do if she develops blood in stool, change in bowel habits, or unexplained weight loss before colonoscopy, she says, "I guess I'd wait until the colonoscopy to mention it?" The nurse reteaches that new symptoms should be reported promptly because they may require diagnostic evaluation sooner.
content.zh:
Maria 表示财务顾问已确认结肠镜作为筛查项目将全额覆盖。结肠镜安排在下个月，届时女儿可照看母亲。空腹化验：血糖 104 mg/dL，总胆固醇 212 mg/dL，LDL 134 mg/dL，HDL 52 mg/dL，甘油三酯 130 mg/dL。医生计划生活方式指导，今日不需用药。生命体征：T 98.1 °F (36.7 °C)，HR 72，BP 122/76，RR 14，室内空气 SpO2 99%。护士在右三角肌接种第一剂重组带状疱疹疫苗，将 Pap 联合 HPV 检测安排在结肠镜准备宣教同一天，并安排 2–6 个月后第二剂带状疱疹疫苗。
回授：Maria 解释结肠镜会用摄像头查看肠道是否有可能发展成癌的增生物，她做检查是因为母亲患过结肠癌。当护士问若结肠镜前出现便血、排便习惯改变或不明原因体重下降应怎么办时，她说：“我想我会等到结肠镜那天再说？” 护士重新说明：若出现新症状，应立即联系诊所，因为可能需要更早进行诊断性评估。

title.zh: 随访结果与第二次回授

summary.en: Maria Delgado is a 52-year-old woman at a new-patient primary care visit after approximately six years without routine care. She feels well but is overdue for several preventive screenings and vaccines. Her mother had colon cancer at age 58. Maria has a high-deductible insurance plan, rotating work hours, caregiver responsibilities for her mother, and a Newest Vital Sign score consistent with a high likelihood of limited health literacy.
summary.zh: Maria Delgado，52 岁，约 6 年未接受常规初级保健，本次为新患者就诊。她自觉无症状，但多项预防性筛查和疫苗接种逾期。她的母亲 58 岁时患结肠癌。Maria 参加高免赔额保险，工作排班轮换，还要照顾母亲；Newest Vital Sign 得分提示高度可能存在健康素养受限。

title.en: Overdue preventive screening and health literacy barriers in a middle-aged adult
title.zh: 中年成人预防性筛查逾期与健康素养障碍

glossary.defZh: 患者获取、理解并使用健康信息做出决定的能力。
请患者用自己的话复述重点，以确认理解是否准确完整。
在没有症状时寻找早期问题或风险的检查。
当有症状或异常发现时，为确定原因而进行的进一步检查。
父母、子女或兄弟姐妹。

correct.en: This case centers on a health-promotion problem rather than an acute disease process: a client with limited health literacy, fear related to a family cancer experience, cost concerns, work constraints, and caregiver responsibilities has delayed preventive care. The nurse first recognizes health-literacy and emotional cues, prioritizes colonoscopy because the clinic protocol places Maria in an increased-risk colorectal-screening group, addresses fear before education, uses teach-back to identify gaps, and builds a concrete plan that reduces scheduling, caregiving, and financial barriers. The final evaluation point is not merely whether Maria can describe the colonoscopy but whether she knows to call promptly for new symptoms rather than waiting for a scheduled screening.
correct.zh: 本病例的核心不是急性疾病，而是健康促进问题：患者因健康素养受限、家族癌症经历带来的恐惧、费用顾虑、工作限制和照护责任而长期延迟预防保健。护士首先识别健康素养和情绪线索；依据诊所方案，因 Maria 属结直肠癌风险增加人群而优先处理结肠镜；先回应恐惧再进行宣教；通过回授法发现理解缺口；并制定能减少排班、照护和经济障碍的具体计划。最终评价重点不仅是她能否描述结肠镜，而是她是否知道如果出现新症状应及时联系诊所，而不是等到已预约的筛查。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

testTakingStrategy.en: In preventive-care cases, separate acute medical instability from health-promotion priorities. Then ask which barrier prevents follow-through and which nursing action makes the plan usable for this specific client.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到预防保健题时，先区分是否有急性不稳定状况；若没有，再判断健康促进的优先事项。随后思考哪个障碍会影响落实，以及哪项护理措施能让这个患者真正执行计划。

tokens.en: Add several new screening and teaching topics at the end of the visit
tokens.zh: 在就诊结束时再增加多项新的筛查和宣教主题

tokens.en: Confirm documented dates and support plans for colonoscopy, Pap/HPV testing, and the second zoster vaccine dose
tokens.zh: 确认结肠镜、Pap/HPV 检测和第二剂带状疱疹疫苗的日期及支持计划已记录

tokens.en: Correct the symptom-reporting gap and confirm with repeat teach-back
tokens.zh: 纠正新症状报告的理解缺口，并再次回授确认

tokens.en: Accept the Stage 3 teach-back as complete because the colonoscopy purpose was explained correctly
tokens.zh: 因其能正确说明结肠镜目的，就认为阶段 3 回授已完整

tokens.en: Undiagnosed chronic disease requiring immediate medication management
tokens.zh: 未诊断慢性病，需要立即药物治疗

tokens.en: Limited health literacy with delayed preventive-care engagement and barriers to screening follow-through
tokens.zh: 健康素养受限导致预防保健延迟，并存在筛查落实障碍

tokens.en: Noncompliance or deliberate disengagement from care
tokens.zh: 不依从或有意脱离医疗护理

tokens.en: Follow-through with scheduled colonoscopy and Pap/HPV appointments
tokens.zh: 是否落实已预约的结肠镜和 Pap/HPV 检测

tokens.en: Accuracy and completeness of teach-back at subsequent visits
tokens.zh: 后续就诊回授的准确性和完整性

tokens.en: Fasting glucose as the primary outcome for this case
tokens.zh: 将空腹血糖作为本病例首要结果指标

tokens.en: Maria's use of professional medical terminology
tokens.zh: Maria 是否使用专业医学术语

glossary.defZh: 患者按计划完成预约、检查和后续行动。
在疾病或并发症出现前进行的筛查、疫苗和健康促进措施。
信息过多导致患者难以理解、记住或应用关键内容。

byChoice.en: This matches the full pattern: limited health literacy, fear, cost and schedule barriers, and improved engagement after tailored nursing support.
byChoice.zh: 这符合完整表现：健康素养受限、恐惧、费用和排班障碍，以及在针对性护理支持后参与度改善。

byChoice.en: Labeling Maria as noncompliant misses the identifiable and modifiable barriers that explain her delayed care.
byChoice.zh: 把 Maria 标记为不依从会忽视导致延迟就医的可识别、可干预障碍。

byChoice.en: Her vital signs and labs do not show an acute condition requiring immediate medication; lifestyle counseling is planned, but it is not the central problem.
byChoice.zh: 她的生命体征和化验不显示需要立即用药的急性状况；可进行生活方式指导，但这不是核心问题。

byChoice.en: This action directly addresses the remaining safety gap: she would wait to report symptoms that require prompt contact.
byChoice.zh: 该措施直接处理剩余安全缺口：她会等待报告需要及时联系诊所的新症状。

byChoice.en: A documented, supported plan converts education into feasible follow-through and reduces barriers.
byChoice.zh: 有记录且有支持的计划能把宣教转化为可执行的随访，并减少障碍。

byChoice.en: This leaves an unsafe omission uncorrected because understanding the purpose is not the same as knowing when to seek help.
byChoice.zh: 这会留下未纠正的不安全遗漏，因为理解目的不等于知道何时求助。

byChoice.en: Adding new topics risks cognitive overload at the moment when the critical safety instruction must be retained.
byChoice.zh: 此时增加新主题可能造成认知负荷，影响她记住关键安全指导。

byChoice.en: Attendance at scheduled screenings is the clearest measure of whether the barrier-reduction plan worked.
byChoice.zh: 是否参加已预约筛查，是判断减少障碍计划是否有效的最直接指标。

byChoice.en: Ongoing teach-back checks whether health-literacy accommodations are effective and retained over time.
byChoice.zh: 持续回授能评估健康素养相关沟通调整是否有效并能否被保持。

byChoice.en: Medical vocabulary is not the goal; accurate plain-language understanding is the goal.
byChoice.zh: 目标不是会使用医学术语，而是能用通俗语言准确理解。

byChoice.en: Glucose is part of routine health maintenance, but it does not measure the success of the screening and health-literacy interventions.
byChoice.zh: 血糖属于常规健康维护的一部分，但不能衡量筛查和健康素养干预是否成功。

correct.en: The resolved problem is limited health literacy and delayed preventive-care engagement with ongoing barriers, not willful noncompliance or an acute chronic-disease medication problem. The priority actions are to close the critical teach-back gap about reporting new symptoms and to confirm that the concrete follow-up plan is documented and supported. The most relevant outcomes are whether Maria attends the planned screenings and whether teach-back remains accurate and complete.
correct.zh: 已明确的问题是健康素养受限和预防保健延迟，并伴随持续障碍；不是故意不依从，也不是需要立即药物处理的急性慢病问题。优先措施是弥补关于新症状报告的关键回授缺口，并确认具体随访计划已记录且有支持。最相关的结果是 Maria 是否完成已安排筛查，以及后续回授是否准确完整。

stem.en: Maria is at the Stage 3 follow-up visit after fear, cost, scheduling, and caregiver barriers have been addressed. Influenza vaccine and the first recombinant zoster vaccine dose have been given. Colonoscopy is scheduled with plan-specific coverage reviewed by the financial counselor, Pap/HPV co-testing is scheduled with the colonoscopy-prep teaching visit, and teach-back has revealed that Maria would wait to report new symptoms before the colonoscopy. Complete the bow-tie diagram.
stem.zh: Maria 已到阶段 3 随访；她的恐惧、费用、排班和照护障碍已被处理。流感疫苗和第一剂重组带状疱疹疫苗已接种。结肠镜已安排，财务顾问已核对其具体保险覆盖；Pap/HPV 联合检测安排在结肠镜准备宣教同一天；回授显示 Maria 若在结肠镜前出现新症状会等待再报告。请完成弓形题图示。

testTakingStrategy.en: For bow-tie items, anchor the condition in the whole case pattern, then choose actions and monitoring parameters that close the highest-risk remaining gaps.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 弓形题要先用整个病例模式确定核心情况，再选择能弥补剩余最高风险缺口的措施和监测指标。
